body_json.answer: The corpus cannot support a "yes, with high confidence" conclusion that the media lies, and it is not a representative sample of the whole corpus. What the posts show is a cluster of claims and accusations that the media lies: "THIS IS FSKE NEWS. LIES. MSM LIES" [T4-009626](#T4-009626); "The media is your true enemy" [T4-008104](#T4-008104); "We no longer fall for your narrative. You've lost us through your continual lies, cover-ups" [T4-009494](#T4-009494); "#LyingMedia" citing alleged CNN and "FusionGPS golden shower" falsehoods [T4-008847](#T4-008847); "These Aren't Reporters — These Are Propagandists!" urging agreement that mainstream media "lies non-stop about Trump" [T4-009504](#T4-009504); "Fake News" [T4-009467](#T4-009467), "Fake News report about fake news" [T4-008246](#T4-008246), "All you need to know about the MSM in one pic #FakeNews" [T4-008284](#T4-008284); Spicer warning "Their Lies Will be Exposed" [T4-009491](#T4-009491); and a headline claim that "The Media Has Become Unhinged" [T4-009021](#T4-009021). Other posts are questions or unrelated: "Do you believe the mainstream media is an enemy of the American people?" [T4-006638](#T4-006638), a satirical "Tell a lie...... #HowToGetMediaAttention" [T4-003159](#T4-003159), a demand that media say "Trump lied" [T4-005724](#T4-005724), a demand on how media frame healthcare cuts [T4-007576](#T4-007576), an accusation that media deflect from #DNCleak [T4-002864](#T4-002864), a lie accusation aimed at Obama [T4-003068](#T4-003068), and vague posts [T4-004476](#T4-004476) [T4-008799](#T4-008799) [T4-000857](#T4-000857) [T4-008161](#T4-008161). These are repeated assertions and opinions, not evidence; repetition does not establish that the media actually lies.
